# **Report summary**

This report documents an ecosystem assessment, as part of the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems, for the `r params$ecosystem_name` `r if(length(params$years) == 0) {        "with no raster years uploaded"      } else if(length(params$years) == 1) {        paste("using data from", params$years)      } else {        paste("using data between", min(params$years), "and", max(params$years))      }`. This report has been created from the Ecosystem Classification Assessment Tool (EcoCAT) developed as part of the EcoCAT project from RBG Kew.
